purpose: Engineering acceleration research only; not a new SLE learning result or formal F2 rerun
teacher_labels: synthetic uniform0/1/S, not real question-bank answer labels
optimizer: one target then one Adam update; normclip1; eta.003/betas.9,.999/eps1e-8; preserve p/m/v/t and perparameter birth-age; no minibatch averaging
precision: p/m/v and gradients float32; original FP64 CE and bias-age correction retained explicitly; no TF32/FP16/fastmath
parity: 64-step selected full p/m/v/t/birth plus logits/CE/argmax compared against original math, atol2e-5/rtol2e-5; report exact-byte equality separately. Passing this engineering probe never proves full-training bitwise replay.
timing: compile/context-init, encode, host-device-transfer, warm compute and validation are separately reported. GPU events and synchronized end-to-end wall; no perstep item()/asnumpy() timing shortcut. CPU receives same preencoded cycle for core comparison.
graph: device index and t must advance on replay, device label/inputs follow32cycle; no Python-side counter advancement masquerading as graph execution. Capture operations are not counted as executed updates unless state t actually advances.
installation: isolated workspace venv/cache only; original primary runtime and all completed study checkpoints untouched
decision: Prefer existing tools first; recommend handwritten fused kernels only if local timing/profiling justifies and separate validation is feasible. Compiled CPU is a measured control. Never infer GPU acceleration from API availability.
